When the tools of the digital age meet the aesthetics of the golden age.

Tim Hayward's Jaguar E-Type keyboard
Evidence: craft excellence, personal hobby, aesthetic joy

The creator claims to have built a keyboard that captures the soul and design excellence of a classic car.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, +1.0) — Lesser Good

The result is a high-quality, bespoke object that fulfills the creator's vision and provides aesthetic value to those who appreciate it.
Resulting Judgement: (+0.5, +1.0) — Lesser Good

Verdict: PASS — The Path of Grace.
The action matches the intent perfectly, creating a localized expansion of beauty and function.
Food writer Tim Hayward describes his journey in building a custom computer keyboard inspired by the iconic Jaguar E-Type, focusing on tactile and visual perfection.

The Poison:
Extreme luxury and bespoke crafting can sometimes border on fetishization of the object over its actual utility.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
No significant error. The WHAT (the keyboard) and the HOW (the build) are in alignment with the WHY (aesthetic satisfaction).

The Trajectory: The Path of Grace.
When the stated goal of beauty is met with the actual production of beauty...
...it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Good. It is a successful localized expansion of the p·t field through creative will.

The Unavoidable Truth: Craftsmanship for its own sake is a valid form of human expression.

The Unavoidable Lie: That you need a $1000 keyboard to type a good sentence.
